release: ADMINISTRATOR MIRROR · NATIVE WINDOWS · DUAL DOMAIN LOCK

classic_engine.status: runtime mirror preserved; app.js, style.css and version.json unchanged

rules: Graphique and Marché are dual-domain native workspaces; they follow the existing Crypto/Métaux domain switch instead of duplicating business DOM.
The precious-metals graph remains inside the original analyst deck and is preserved when the Graphique window is detached, minimized or maximized.
The precious-metals market area remains inside the original Market zone and is preserved when the Marché window is detached, minimized or maximized.
Window Deck titles follow the active domain: Crypto or Métaux précieux.
No generated docked window bars or semantic wrappers.
Minimize masks presentation only and never suspends Classic runtime logic.
A floating shell exists only while detached and moves original DOM nodes; no business content is cloned.

dual_domain_contract.domain_source: document.documentElement.dataset.atlasMarketDomain written by the preserved Classic runtime
dual_domain_contract.metals: Graphique · Métaux précieux / Marché · Métaux précieux

window_features: drag when free mode is enabled
global reset to native Classic flow
Escape restores maximized window or closes Window Deck

suspension_contract.reason: Classic 38.15.11 business runtime remains monolithic; 39.2.3 does not fake suspension.
suspension_contract.current_behavior: Minimize/hide affects presentation only; existing Crypto, Métaux, WebSocket, timer and analytical runtime behavior is preserved.
suspension_contract.future: True suspend/resume can be introduced module by module only after lifecycle-safe runtime separation.

supersedes.39.2.1: rejected: semantic wrappers/chrome altered docked Classic layout
supersedes.39.2.2: superseded: native windows base omitted explicit dual-domain identity for the Métaux précieux graph/market

notes: 39.2.3 keeps the Native Windows architecture and explicitly locks the existing precious-metals graph into the Graphique domain window.
No second metals graph is created: the original Classic analyst deck remains the single source of visual truth and switches between Crypto and Métaux.
The Window Deck and control accessibility labels update when the existing domain switch changes Crypto ↔ Métaux précieux.
A new localStorage namespace prevents older rejected window states from contaminating 39.2.3.
Classic /web remains the stable public reference; /administrator remains the operator cockpit.
